ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Refer to the titration curve below, which is of a weak base titrated with a strong acid. The pH was measured with a pH meter after small volumes of 0.125 M HCl were added to 25.0 mL of a weak base. Data from that experiment are shown in the above graph. For the best results with a visual indicator (one that changes color), what will optimize the results?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: Choose an indicator that has a pK that is close to the end point pH.
